ov: The North American brown bear, a population or subspecies of the brown bear. Some brown bears elsewhere, such as the Kodiak and Kamchatka bears, are sometimes also called grizzlies.

cf.tip: A grizzly is a brown bear: the name is used for the North American population.
The black bear is smaller than the grizzly and a better tree-climber.

fx: “Grizzly” probably means grizzled: its fur has grey-tipped hairs.
